sentences.en: Multinational corporations outperform traditional corporations operating in just one country.
sentences.zh: 跨国公司在仅在一个国家运营的传统公司中表现更优。

sentences.en: Algeria can outperform its neighbors economically.
sentences.zh: 阿尔及利亚在经济上可以优于其邻国。

sentences.en: Our sales team aims to outperform last year's results.
sentences.zh: 我们的销售团队旨在超越去年的成绩。

senses.zh: 做得比…更好，胜过v.（机器等）性能比…好
